top_signals.title: Dove owner Unilever hikes prices as energy costs surge
top_signals.summary: Dove owner Unilever hiked its prices over the summer as it looked to offset rising energy costs caused by the Iran war.  The FTSE 100 consumer goods group told shareholders on Wednesday its prices rose by 2.3 per cent in its third quarter, as its sales growth slowed from 5.5 to 2.9 per cent.
